written_at: at data preparation, before training (L4.1 confirmatory setup)

clean_control.role: clean control (same slice and hyperparameters, no flip)

detection_rule: FAIRNESS flagged in a run iff risks_triggered non-empty or aspect_scoring in {risk_detected, scored_risk} (compare_ground_truth.evidence_flag_one); flagged for a model iff flagged in a majority of its runs

hypotheses.H1: No clean control is flagged (FAIRNESS control flag rate = 0)
hypotheses.H2: Flip models at rates >= 0.4 are flagged (FAIRNESS evidence-level recall)
hypotheses.H3: EOD increases with flip rate (Spearman rho over rates 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0)
hypotheses.H4: Gate behaviour: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / mapping_blocked count per model, reported as-is
